hints.title: Symmetric Character Pairing
hints.text: Consider working from the outside inward. For each character on the left side, find its matching partner starting from the far right.

hints.title: Greedy Right-to-Left Search
hints.text: Scan from the right end towards the current left pointer to locate the matching character. Swapping it step-by-step to the mirrored right position is optimal.

hints.title: Central Character Handling
hints.text: If a character has no other matching occurrence, it belongs in the center of the palindrome. Move it to the center or defer its displacement until the end.

hints.title: Two-Pointer Swap Implementation

complexity.notes: Each swap moves a character closer to its target position across length n.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all permutations of swaps causes exponential time complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Converting string to mutable array takes O(n) space for easier adjacent swaps.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate recognizes greedy matching from outer bounds to inner center.
